pr_title: Fix score panel not showing silver rank badges on hidden and flashlight plays

issue_context.title: Silver S/SS don't show on results screen
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:** 
When playing with Hidden or Flashlight, the S and SS icons on the results graph use gold letters, unlike the silver letters seen on leaderboards.

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/10366615/86302722-8875b680-bbd7-11ea-9af3-e674b61aaa1d.png)

**osu!lazer version:** 
2020.629.0

**Logs:**
[runtime.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/4861341/runtime.log)
[performance.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/4861343/performance.log)

review_comments: Note: This matches `ModHidden`, but eventually needs to be moved into `ScoreProcessor` itself.
